scripts.preversion: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Working tree is not clean; commit or stash first.' && exit 1)
scripts.bump:patch: bump patch --commit 'Version %s.' --all package.json package-lock.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.bump:minor: bump minor --commit 'Version %s.' --all package.json package-lock.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.bump:major: bump major --commit 'Version %s.' --all package.json package-lock.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.bump: f() { bump "$1" --commit 'Version %s.' --all package.json package-lock.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml; }; f
